pr_title: Fix a wrong team parameter being used for ObserverStatsLogic translations
pr_body:
Closes #20229.

However, I noticed this displays `Team 0` instead of `No Team` now. I don't understand fluent well enough to see right away what the problem is here, maybe @Mailaender can give some insight. EDIT: See https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/pull/20230#issuecomment-1230165304.
pr_comments:
Actually, I found the issue(?) with `Team 0` vs `No Team`. Apparently you have to use `[0]` instead of `[zero]` in the translation file. I'm not sure why `[zero]` doesn't seem to work here but in does in other places? (Or do we have a lot of wrong set ups that nobody noticed yet?)
EDIT: See https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/pull/20230#discussion_r957237228.
#20229 isn't addressed in #20048 (and it shouldn't need to be)
oh I see, it was addressed in an older version

issue_context.title: Team cash is displayed incorrectly
issue_context.body: Likely a regression from #20142

review_comments: The parameter is `$team` here, that is the bug!
Notice that the translation *key* passed to `GetString` is `Team` which resolves to `team-no-team`.
